sources.title: 承銷價僅50元！台積電、蘋果唯一合格鎢供應商 聯友金屬9月9日登創新板
sources.locator: Paragraph beginning「聯友金屬以『城市採礦』與『循環經濟』為核心策略」
sources.note: States Lianyou is the only qualified tungsten-metal supplier in Taiwan for TSMC and other named companies, without defining the exclusivity scope or providing supporting supplier data.

sources.title: TSMC 2024 Annual Report
sources.note: Describes TSMC's conflict-free tungsten requirements but does not identify suppliers or establish exclusivity.

sources.title: 聯友金屬科技股份有限公司 — investor presentation hosted by Taiwan Stock Exchange
sources.effective_period: Presentation includes company data as of 2025-09-30.
sources.note: Identifies the issuer's tungsten products and plans, but does not substantiate TSMC qualification or sole-supplier status.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused searches and checks of issuer, exchange-hosted, media, and TSMC materials found secondary reporting of the assertion but no verifiable supplier record or defined basis for exclusivity. The exclusivity atom remains UNKNOWN.
The supplier and exclusivity assertions are reported by secondary media; the reviewed TSMC disclosure does not confirm the relationship or identify a supplier.
The issuer's exchange-hosted presentation lists tungsten products including sodium tungstate, but does not specify what product the reported TSMC supply concerns.
No denominator, qualification criteria, geographic boundary beyond the phrase「在台」, or effective period was found for the word「唯一」.
